positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Coinbase Exchange
- Create dual a trading data streaming system to drop e2e latency by 50% for verified users.
- Optimized Datadog + AWS usage to save on hardware and logging costs resulting in a 15% decrease in expenses
- Migrate REST API from node.js to Golang, resulting in improved reliability (95% drop in errors) and performance
- Increased throughput for orders submissions and cancellations by improving request batching (up to 50% throughput)
- Optimized DB queries by denormalizing data, trading data size for performance, to speed up look ups by 90%
- Mentored an intern by designed and coordinating a project resulting in a successful launch that improved the exchange
- Harden trading systems so that clients are not impacted in the case of a server or network failure
- Responded and coordinated for failures during on-call and ensured a timely solution
positions.insights: Skills: Node.js · Software Design · Low Latency Trading · High Throughput · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Data Streaming · Go (Programming Language) · Trading Systems

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Exchange Team, Coinbase Pro
- Designed, created, and streamlined new product launches to the main trading engine saving 1 day of engineering time per launch
- Implemented a maximum limit of open orders per product requiring significant changes to various APIs, services, and databases verified using unit, integration, and acceptance testing
- Optimized the core trading engine to be more efficient and minimize latency
- Patched various bugs and potential attack vectors to remove memory leaks and database freezes

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Developed a diagnostics tool for online advertisers decreasing client downtime from 2/3 days to less than 4 hours using Node.js, Angular, Golang, Python deployed using a containerized approach
- Setup and networked services behind a reverse proxy within a network DMZ
- Integrated telemetry, metrics monitoring, and heart beat using Prometheus to monitor 4 micro services containers
- Implemented automated testing suite (Protractor.js), linting, and image building using docker and CI/CD tools to reduce deployment times by 30%
